notes.title: 0417 Update
notes.notes:
Fixed:
All language: Doesn't give you a save that jump to title screen after game cleared anymore.
Korean: Remove the mosaic.

- - - - -
About the Free Battle:
The "Free Battle" that is unlocked when the game is cleared does not refer to an infinite combat endgame feature. It only refers to the NPCs unlocked in the basement that could start a sandbox battle.

關於自由戰鬥的詳細說明：
遊戲通關時提示解鎖的"自由戰鬥"環節，並不是指一個類似無盡模式的無限戰鬥模式，僅指基地地下室中心解鎖的，可以進入沙盒戰鬥的NPC。
